reason: A provider integration that connects DeepSeek Harness to NewAPI, LiteLLM, Higress, and other OpenAI-compatible LLM gateways, discovers available models, and routes requests over supported protocols.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 NewAPI、LiteLLM、Higress 及其他兼容网关，发现模型并通过多种协议发送请求。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to NewAPI, LiteLLM, Higress, and other compatible gateways to discover models and route requests over multiple protocols.

capabilities: Connects to configured LLM gateway endpoints
Reads model catalogs from gateway APIs
Sends chat and streaming requests using supported protocols
Stores or accesses configured API credentials
Provides a settings interface for gateway and model configuration
